name: Bizzmudra
author: Saiful Islam

sections.description:
Bizzmudra allows you to easily add a powerful and user-friendly multi-currency switcher to your WooCommerce store. With this plugin, customers can view product prices in their preferred currency, helping improve user experience and boost international sales.

The plugin supports manual exchange rate configuration, giving store owners full control over currency values without relying on third-party APIs. You can add multiple currencies, set custom exchange rates, and seamlessly switch prices across the shop, cart, and checkout pages.

Designed to be lightweight, fast, and easy to use, Bizz Multi Currency Switcher integrates smoothly with WooCommerce and works out of the box with most themes.

Key Features

  • Add new currencies to your WooCommerce store
  • Manually set and manage exchange rates
  • Simple and intuitive currency switcher
  • Automatically convert product prices
  • Compatible with WooCommerce shop, cart, and checkout pages
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • Easy to use shortcode and widget for displaying the currency switcher

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce → Multi Currency in the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Add the desired currencies and set their exchange rates.
  4. Save your settings.
  5. The currency switcher will automatically appear on shop and product pages.
  6. Customers can select their preferred currency, and prices will update accordingly.

Shortcode

Use the shortcode [bizzmudra_currency_switcher] to display the currency switcher anywhere on your site.

Widget

Add the “Currency Switcher” widget to your sidebar or any widget area to display the currency switcher.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bizzmudra directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Multi Currency to configure the plugin.
  4. Add currencies and set their exchange rates.
  5. Use the shortcode [bizzmudra_currency_switcher] to display the currency switcher anywhere on your site.
  6. Alternatively, add the “Currency Switcher” widget to your sidebar or widget area.
sections.faq:
How many currencies can I add?

You can add up to 3 currencies in the free version. The Pro version supports unlimited currencies.

How do I update exchange rates?

Exchange rates must be updated manually from the admin panel. Go to WooCommerce → Multi Currency and update the rates for each currency.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. The currency switcher can be displayed using a shortcode or widget.

Will prices be converted in the cart and checkout?

Yes, all prices throughout the shop, cart, and checkout pages will be converted based on the selected currency.

How do I display the currency switcher?

You can display the currency switcher in three ways:
1. Use the shortcode [bizzmudra_currency_switcher] in any post, page, or widget area
2. Add the “Currency Switcher” widget to your sidebar
3. The switcher automatically displays on shop and product pages
